created.description: Create a coordination task. Coordination only; grants no remote tool permission.

due_at.description: Optional due time, UTC whole seconds.

owner_identity.description: did:key of the owning agent identity.

updated.description: Update task status. Terminal transitions: done or canceled never return to open without a new event.

task_id.description: Lowercase canonical UUIDv4 of the task.created event.

description: Task payloads: task.created, task.updated. The envelope's protected event_type selects the variant.
title: Task payloads
